# ILP Study — International Learning Pathways

> ILP Study (trading as International Learning Pathways) is Bangladesh's premier education consultancy specializing exclusively in higher education admissions, government scholarships (CSC), and student visa facilitation for Chinese universities. Headquartered in Mirpur, Dhaka, with liaison representation in Harbin, China.

## Organization & Contact Information
- **Organization Name**: International Learning Pathways (ILP Study)
- **Primary Website**: https://ilpstudy.com

## Core Admissions Pathways & Programs
ILP Study facilitates admissions into over 130 accredited Chinese universities across all major academic hubs (Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Harbin, Wuhan, Guangzhou, Hangzhou).

- [Degree & Study Programs](https://ilpstudy.com/study-program): Comprehensive guide to Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, MBBS, Pre-University Foundation, and Chinese Language routes.
- [Harbin Pathway Program](https://ilpstudy.com/study-program#pathways): Strategic dual-stage pathway: Start in March with an intensive Chinese language program and qualify for up to 100% degree scholarships for the September academic intake.
- [Chinese University Directory](https://ilpstudy.com/universities): Directory of 130+ Chinese universities with official locations, provincial rankings, and annual tuition brackets.
- [Scholarship Advisory (CSC & Provincial)](https://ilpstudy.com/scholarships): In-depth guide to Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type A Bilateral & Type B University Independent), Provincial Government awards, and institutional full tuition waivers.
- [CSCA Exam Preparation](https://ilpstudy.com/csca): Guidance, test dates, registration windows, and syllabus (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment.
- [China Student Visa (X1 & X2)](https://ilpstudy.com/visa): Step-by-step visa application protocols, JW202/JW201 form processing, physical examination attestation, and Chinese Embassy Dhaka procedures.

---

## Interactive Student Planning Tools
- [RMB Student Budget Calculator](https://ilpstudy.com/budget): Interactive tool to calculate tuition, campus accommodation, meals, residence permits, and RMB to BDT living costs.
- [Application Document Checklist](https://ilpstudy.com/checklist): Interactive verified checklist for passports, notarized academic certificates, recommendation letters, physical examinations, and police clearance.
- [Student Life in China Guide](https://ilpstudy.com/student-life): Preparation for campus life, halal food availability, Alipay/WeChat payments, campus dormitories, and transport networks.
- [Student Resources & Toolkits](https://ilpstudy.com/resources): Centralized resource hub linking official portals (CSC, CSCSE, Ministry of Education PRC).

---

## Knowledge Base & Admissions Guides
- [Blog & Student Journal](https://ilpstudy.com/blogs): 18 comprehensive, verified guides covering admissions after HSC/SSC, MBBS in China, studying without IELTS, March vs. September intakes, and CSCA 4-week study plans.
- [Free Admissions Consultation](https://ilpstudy.com/contact): Direct online consultation request form with Resend email confirmation and instant WhatsApp routing.
- [Editorial & Verification Standards](https://ilpstudy.com/how-we-check): Explanation of how ILP Study verifies university information directly from official Ministry of Education and institutional gazettes.
